title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data

translated_title: FaST：面向离线强化学习的转移因子化合成
translated_abstract: 合成数据增强有望使离线强化学习突破固定记录数据集的限制而实现规模扩展，但主流的基于扩散模型的生成器将转移元组（状态、动作、下一状态、奖励、终止标志）建模为一个不可分割的整体：没有任何单一因子能够被原生地单独重新生成。我们提出了FaST（转移的因子化合成），它通过链式法则将转移分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励和终止五个阶段，并为每个阶段配备与其统计特性相匹配的估计器。在十二个D4RL运动控制和迷宫基准测试中，基于FaST生成的转移训练的TD3+BC和IQL智能体达到了SynthER扩散基线的性能水平，同时生成转移的速度快90倍以上。显式的“给定状态下的动作”条件分布还可以针对固定状态进行重新查询，从而实现有针对性的动作合成：为每个生成的状态抽取N个候选动作，并保留在基于相同数据拟合的价值函数下具有最高优势值的动作。
tldr: FaST通过链式法则将强化学习转移分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励和终止五个阶段分别建模，在匹配扩散基线性能的同时将合成速度提升90倍以上，并支持针对固定状态进行高优势动作的定向合成。
en_tdlr: FaST factors transitions via the chain rule into separate state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, matching diffusion-baseline performance while generating transitions over 90x faster and enabling targeted synthesis of high-advantage actions for fixed states.
